name: Boron
short: Human safety has not been studied systematically; a review warns excessive use may be harmful. Boric acid poisoning has been fatal, and animal studies show reproductive toxicity.
text: A structured evidence review found a lack of systematic study on the safety of boron in humans and concluded that excessive use may be harmful and that caution is advised. A toxicology review reported that deaths have occurred after swallowing boric acid and after skin exposure to it (these are poisoning cases, not supplement trials), and that the harmful effects seen in animal studies were weight loss and reproductive toxicity. No interaction data were found in the cited sources.
